jobs.description: Company DescriptionWork as a Warehouse Worker (m/f/d) at Redcare Pharmacy and earn a net salary of 2.076€ per month + travel allowance + vacation bonus!Conduct an AI interview with our digital Recruiting Assistant Reddi — anytime, anywhere!As soon as you submit your application, you will receive a link via email for the first interview.About Redcare Pharmacy:As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy, Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy, collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values, join us and begin your #Redcareer today.Job DescriptionAbout your tasks: ✓ You will handle incoming goods and store all incoming products, distributing them appropriately in our warehouse✓ You will precisely pick our products, ensuring the complete processing of customer orders ✓ You will carefully pack customer orders and guarantee a smooth shipping✓You carry out regular quality checks and ensure that damaged or faulty products are identified and removed at an early stage✓You keep your work area organized and clean, contributing to a safe and efficient warehouse environmentQualificationsAbout you:  ✓ You are an EU citizen or hold a Dutch work permit ✓ You can understand and speak German or English without difficulty ✓ You have a driver’s license and a car or motorcycle, etc., to commute independently to the workplace in Sevenum (Note: There is no public transport connection) ✓ You are able to perform a standing job for up to 8 hours a day and walk more than 15,000 steps ✓ You don’t need years of warehouse experience, as long as you are willing to learn new tasks ✓ You are reliable and punctual and willing to work every second Saturday of the month, also in a 2-shift-system (early shift and late shift)Additional InformationAbout our benefits:In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs – whether it’s living a healthy life, having enough time for your needs, or developing your skills – we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits:   ✓Mobility: Not all employees live close to our office. That’s why we support our employees with your daily commute with a travel allowance. This compensation is paid to you with 25 cents per kilometer in addition to your net salary.  ✓Vacation: We can offer you 28 vacation days and a vacation pay once per year (96 % of your monthly gross) in addition to your salary.✓Redcare events: We promote team-building through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties. ✓Employee discount: Several times a year, we offer you discounted employee sales directly at the Sevenum location as well as 10 % off on our assortment for all employees.  ✓Employee referral program: Because our employees know best who fits in with us, successful recommendations are rewarded with a bonus.

Your challenge- Product Compliance: Ensure semiconductor manufacturing equipment meets EU Machinery Regulation (EU 2023/1230), LVD, EMC, and SEMI standards.- Conformity Assessment: Conduct product conformity assessments following CE, UL, and SEMI safety standards, and comply with regional standards where AIXTRON operates.- Safety Requirements Management: Allocate and manage safety requirements at system, subsystem, and component level, ensuring traceability and consistency.- Risk Assessments: Conduct safety risk assessments in line with ISO 12100 and Chemical Risk Assessments for product development and modifications of existing product lines.- Reaction Analysis: Review and analyse exothermic reactions and explosive substances within chemical kinetics, reaction engineering, and process safety. In addition, you can increase your annual leave through a salary conversion model.- Profit sharing: As an employee, you have the opportunity to participate in the company’s success and benefit from a profit-sharing scheme.- Health: We are committed to providing support for your physical and mental health, e.g., through regular health campaigns.- Personal development: It is important to us that you continue to evolve your skills, be it with the help of our own AIXTRON Academy or through personalized development programs.- Corporate Benefits: As part of our Corporate Benefits program, you benefit from exclusive discounts with numerous partner companies.- Retirement benefits and additional insurance: We support your retirement planning and offer capital-forming benefits as well as individual supplementary insurance options.- Catering: In our company cafeteria, you can enjoy subsidized meals as well as fresh seasonal fruit baskets.- Open corporate culture: We foster an open and respectful culture – first-name terms – that extends across all hierarchical levels.- Sustainability and mobility: We are committed to sustainability and provide EV charging stations for cars and bicycles, as well as convenient transport connections and free parking spaces.- Employee referral program: If you help attract new talent to AIXTRON, we will reward you generously through our employee referral program.

You will carry out a range of surveying activities including construction surveying, setting out, as-built surveys, and engineering surveying using the latest surveying, laser scanning, and geospatial technologies.This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career while contributing to one of Europe's most significant and technologically advanced construction projects.What You’ll Do- Carry out construction surveying activities on large-scale building and industrial construction projects.- Perform setting out and setting out works for structural, civil, and infrastructure elements.- Conduct as-built surveys to verify completed works and document project progress.- Deliver accurate engineering surveying services in accordance with project specifications and quality standards.- Work as part of a surveying team under the guidance of an experienced Geospatial Engineer.- Establish and densify survey control networks in line with industry best practices.- Operate modern surveying equipment, including Total Stations, GNSS receivers, laser scanners, imaging equipment, GPS systems, and data collectors.- Validate survey measurements using GNSS, Total Station, and laser scanning technologies.- Prepare and manage setting out data for upload to survey instruments.- Process and analyse survey data using software such as AutoCAD, StarNet, and Leica Cyclone.- Carry out regular calibration checks and maintenance of survey equipment and accessories.- Undertake additional project and surveying-related tasks as required.What You Will Bring- Completed vocational training, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Surveying, Geomatics, or a related field.- Experience in construction surveying, engineering surveying, setting out, or as-built surveying would be advantageous.- Previous experience working on construction sites within the building construction, industrial construction, or infrastructure sectors is desirable.- Understanding of surveying principles, methodologies, and geospatial data collection techniques.- Experience working with modern surveying equipment, including Total Stations and GNSS systems.- Experience with laser scanning technologies and related software (e.g. Leica Cyclone) would be beneficial.- Eligibility to work in Germany.- Good communication skills in English; German language skills would be advantageous.- Highly motivated, quality-focused, responsible, and able to work effectively as part of a team.Benefits You Will LoveAt Murphy Geospatial – A Woolpert Company, you’ll join a collaborative and innovative team where your expertise makes a real impact. Our benefits include:- Competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits package aligned to your experience- Access to cutting‑edge geospatial technology and industry‑leading tools- Flexible working options designed to support work–life balance- Enhanced wellbeing support, including employee assistance initiatives- Opportunities within a growing, globally connected organisation through our partnership with Woolpert- Principal Programme: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.- Performance‑related bonus scheme that rewards your contribution- Fitness and Wellbeing reimbursement programme.Equal Employment OpportunityWoolpert is an equal‑opportunity employer committed to full inclusion of all individuals. We recruit, train, and promote without regard to protected characteristics. For more information, see our EEO resources. Applicants requiring accommodation during recruitment may contact MGS.talentteam@woolpert.com (https://mailto:MGS.talentteam@woolpert.com)  Agency Notice Please do not contact any employee of Woolpert or its subsidiaries about this requisition. Agencies not engaged by the Woolpert Talent Acquisition Team will not be eligible for fee payment.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Building Information Modeling - BIM, 3-D-Laserscanning, GPS Global Positioning System, Projektmanagement, Ingenieurvermessung, Topografische Vermessung, Vermessung, CAD (Computer Aided Design)-Systeme anwenden, Geomatik, Baustellenvermessung, Topografie, Kartografie

jobs.occupation: IMPACT PORTFOLIO MANAGER (Fairer Futures Programmes) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: Overview:Fairtrade is the most recognized and trusted sustainability label, working to make trade fairer for people and planet.For more than three decades, Fairtrade has been making an impact on the way trade works. We believe that every farmer and worker should have access to a better way of doing business, and a better way of living. Fairtrade International is an independent non-profit organisation representing more than two million small-scale farmers and workers worldwide. It owns the FAIRTRADE Mark, a registered trademark that appears on more than 37,000 products. Beyond certification, Fairtrade International and its member organisations (three producer networks and 19 national Fairtrade organisations) partner with producers and businesses, engage consumers, and advocate for a fair and sustainable future.Unit’s description and purpose: The Global Impact unit strengthens the Fairtrade system by driving institutional learning and effectiveness through robust monitoring and evaluation systems. We are the hub for the analysis and communication of high-quality data and information about Fairtrade and its impact, as well as supporting strategy delivery. The unit includes the Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) team, which is the Fairtrade system’s hub for MEL which directly connects evidence to strategic decision for the Global Strategy, individual Fairtrade projects and global programmes, Standards, producer support, and more.PRINCIPAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:Role purpose: The Impact Portfolio Manager (Fairer Futures Programmes) is responsible for stewarding the MEL frameworks for several of Fairtrade’s global product programmes, the flagship programmatic vehicles through which Fairtrade delivers measurable impact for farmers and workers under its 2026–2028 Global Strategy. The manager will share responsibilities for a total of three programmes (cocoa, banana, coffee) with another manager, with product- and thematic-specific focus to be determined upon hire.Working in close collaboration with Fairtrade Producer Networks, Global Product Teams, and the Digital Service Unit, the role ensures that both programmes are underpinned by robust, coherent, and actionable MEL, from framework design through data collection, reporting, evaluation, and learning. The position serves as one of Fairtrade International's primary MEL contact across programme discussions, representing the Global Impact unit in a system that spans FI, National Fairtrade Organizations, and Producer Networks. This role also contributes to the Global Impact unit's impact services offer, drawing on programme MEL expertise to identify and develop customized services for the Fairtrade system and external partners.Main Responsibilities:            - MEL Framework, Indicators, and Data Management. Steward and drive the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Theory of Change and MEL framework for several of the Fairer Futures Programmes, working in close collaboration with Producer Networks and Global Product Teams. Steward the KPI and activity/output indicator set for both programmes, including maintaining metadata and monitoring data quality. Work with PN MEL staff, Global Product Teams, and where needed external consultants to ensure systematic consolidation of existing programme data and the design and implementation of regular data collection processes. Coordinate with the Information & Knowledge team on data cleaning, analysis, and visualisation.- Stakeholder Engagement and Project MEL Alignment. Serve as Fairtrade International's primary MEL contact for the product-expert colleagues in Producer Networks and Global Product Teams, providing technical MEL guidance, supporting capacity on data collection and reporting, and ensuring programme MEL requirements are understood and operationalised across the system. Work with PNs to ensure that MEL frameworks for individual projects within both programme portfolios are aligned to the overarching programme frameworks, providing where capacity is available guidance and quality assurance at project inception and during implementation- Reporting, Synthesis, and Learning. Lead the preparation of programme-level MEL reporting for programmes, synthesising data and evidence from across the programme portfolio into outputs that feed into the overall strategy reporting cycle. Facilitate learning processes within programmes, identifying evidence-based insights and working with Global Product Teams and PNs to support programme adaptation where warranted. Ensure programme MEL evidence and KPI data are appropriately integrated into the overall strategy MEL cycle in close coordination with the designated strategy MEL lead within the Impact Management team.- Programme Evaluation. Lead the design, commissioning, and management of the programme evaluations. This includes developing evaluation questions in collaboration with PNs and Global Product Teams, overseeing evaluation partners, and ensuring findings are translated into actionable learning.- Impact Services and External Engagement. Identify opportunities to offer MEL technical services to Fairtrade system organisations and external partners, drawing on expertise developed through the programmes. Contribute to the scoping, design, and pitching of impact services in collaboration with the Head, with a particular focus on programme MEL, data collection design, and evaluation. Participate actively in relevant system-wide working groups, representing the Impact Management team's MEL perspective on cross-organisational initiatives.Other tasks that are consistent with the level and responsibilities of this post.SKILLS REQUIRED:Level of education: The position holder will have a Master’s degree or higher in development economics, econometrics, applied sociology, social sciences or another relevant field in management or natural sciences. Years of professional experience: A minimum of five years' experience in monitoring, evaluation, and learning, with demonstrable experience designing and managing MEL frameworks for multi-stakeholder projects or programmes. At least two years' experience working in or with stakeholders from the Global South, preferably in agricultural or commodity supply chain contexts. Experience in coffee and bananas is an advantage.Language requirements: Fluency in English required. Professional proficiency in Spanish is a advantage. Job Specific Competencies/knowledge: - Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning- Project and Programme Management- International Development Expertise- Stakeholder Management- Planning and execution- Data Collection Design and Management- Evaluation Design and Commissioning- Enhancing data-driven decision making- Data Analysis (quantitative and qualitative)- Data Reporting and Synthesis- Capacity BuildingPersonal Qualities: - Cross-cultural communication- Facilitation- Rapid Learning- Collaboration/Teamwork- Customer Service- Presentation Skills- Relationship Management- Evidence Collecting- Flexibility- Feedback sourcingSoftware/Tools: - Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook, Powerpoint, Teams, Planner)- Kobo Toolbox (or similar survey design and implementation tools)- Miro (or similar online whiteboarding tools)- Canva (or similar graphic design tools)- Claude.ai (or similar AI  tools)- Toladata (or similar project monitoring MEL platform)- Power BI (or similar business intelligence software)TERMS AND CONDITIONS:- This is a two-year full-time position within Fairtrade International.- Location is at Fairtrade International offices in Bonn, Germany with the opportunity for hybrid work arrangements- The office language is English.- Salary as per the Collective Bargaining Agreement for the Wholesale and Foreign Trade Industries for North Rhine Westphalia Group 6a and over tariff payments starting from €5455 Gross per month- Holiday Bonus and 13th salary  - 30 days of holidays per year (for fulltime employees)- Subsidised public transportation ticket- Subsidised meal services- Childcare cost subsidy Please note that Fairtrade International is strict on compliance with the required qualification criteria mentioned above, and only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

OVERVIEW:Fairtrade is the most recognized and trusted sustainability label, working to make trade fairer for people and planet.For more than three decades, Fairtrade has been making an impact on the way trade works. We believe that every farmer and worker should have access to a better way of doing business, and a better way of living. Fairtrade International is an independent non-profit organisation representing more than two million small-scale farmers and workers worldwide. It owns the FAIRTRADE Mark, a registered trademark that appears on more than 37,000 products. Beyond certification, Fairtrade International and its member organisations (three producer networks and 19 national Fairtrade organisations) partner with producers and businesses, engage consumers, and advocate for a fair and sustainable future. Unit’s description and purpose: Global Products, Programs and Policy (GPPP) provides leadership to the Fairtrade system with selected product, program and policy intelligence. To this end GPPP provides information, tools and strategic direction as the main outputs. GPPP facilitates and contributes to coherent implementation of strategic plans within the Fairtrade system. GPPP develops new ways of delivering Fairtrade’s intended impact in a changing business environment and risk context.PRINCIPAL ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:Role purpose: The Cocoa Manager is responsible for implementation of GPPP cocoa works based on work schedule agreed with the Senior Advisor Cocoa. The work will deliver measurable impact for farmers and workers under its 2026–2028 Global Strategy. The Cocoa Manager joins a team that works fluidly, sharing responsibilities across multiple workstreams supporting each other where the need is the greatest to achieve their objectives. The environment is dynamic and priorities can shift with external events impacting workplans.  In addition to other duties the Cocoa Manager, working within GPPP cocoa, will  work in close collaboration with Producer Networks, National Fairtrade Organisations and the Fairtrade International Global Impact team responsible for Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning, to ensure the Fairer Futures Programme – West Africa Cocoa is implemented professionally and on time. The programme is primarily focused on increasing the household income of farmers who are members of Small Producer Organisaitons in the programme. The programme leads to farm level interventions through Small Producer Organisaitons including pruning, cocoa tree planting and shade tree planting among others. The programme includes further interventions on income such as Village Savings and Loans Association, and interventions on social compliance including increasing the effectiveness of child labour monitoring, reporting and remediation. Future working responsibilities may extend to other geographies and other commodities.Main Responsibilities:            - Supporting National Fairtrade Organisations, in their responsibilities to maintain and grow the market for Fairtrade cocoa.- Supporting Producer Networks, in their work with Small Producer Organisations, and maintaining and growing the market for Fairtrade cocoa.- Programme design. Work with stakeholders, and mostly importantly the Producer Network, to ensure programme design is based on evidence with robust monitoring, evaluation and learning contributing to the evolution of the programme.- Programme implementation. Co-management with the Producer Network based on agreed reporting structures and formats providing oversight and reporting to stakeholders in a timely manner. This will include the running of, and reporting to, a working committee.- Financial reporting.  Responsible for ensuring timely quarterly financial reporting including an understanding of any variance from plan and agreed actions to remediate that situation.- Programme monitoring, evaluation and learning. Working with Fairtrade International monitoring, evaluation and learning experts and the Producer Network to ensure implementation and prioritisation of effective monitoring, evaluation and learning in a timely manner.- External programme reporting. Working with Fairtrade International monitoring, evaluation and learning experts, Producer Network and National Fairtrade Organisations ensuring agreed reporting deadlines are met with quality reporting to be used with commercial stakeholders, government and other interested stakeholders.- External stakeholder engagement, traders. Working closely with the Producer Network manage relationships with exporter, importer and processers of cocoa who purchase Fairtrade cocoa from Small Producer Organisaitons. Traders are a critical part of the supply chain and their incorporation into the programme is desired and necessary.- External stakeholder engagement, events. Working with National Fairtrade Organisations you will be speaking at public and trade events on the strategic objectives of our work, the progress and impact with the aim of influencing the sector.- External stakeholder engagement, media. Where required you will interact with media.- Fairtrade Standards and Pricing. Liaising with the lead department in Fairtrade on standards and pricing, Fairtrade’s Standards Unit and Pricing Unit, you will be working on standards and pricing matters relating to Fairtrade’s cocoa work and the programme. This will include and not limited to consultations, queries and evolution of standards and pricing. Other tasks that are consistent with the level and responsibilities of this post.SKILLS REQUIRED:Level of education: The position holder will have an undergraduate degree in science or the arts. Years of professional experience: A minimum of three years' experience in complex project management which includes implementation in the global South and preferably West Africa.Language requirements: Fluency in English and French required. Professional proficiency in Spanish is an advantage. Job Specific Competencies/knowledge: - Project and Programme Management- People management, particularly where they are not under your direct management- Stakeholder Management- International Development Expertise- Planning and execution- Financial reporting- Negotiation- Public speaking- Capacity BuildingPersonal Qualities: - Cross-cultural communication- Facilitation- Rapid Learning- Collaboration/Teamwork- Customer Service- Presentation Skills- Relationship Management- Evidence Collecting- Flexibility- Seeking and action on feedback Software/Tools:- Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook, Powerpoint, Teams, Planner)- Miro (or similar online whiteboarding tools)TERMS AND CONDITIONS:- This is a two-year full-time position within Fairtrade International.- Location is at Fairtrade International offices in Bonn, Germany with the opportunity for hybrid work arrangements- The office language is English- Salary as per the Collective Bargaining Agreement for the Wholesale and Foreign Trade Industries for North Rhine Westphalia Group 6a and over tariff payments starting from €5455 Gross per month- Holiday Bonus and 13th salary  - 30 days of holidays per year (for fulltime employees)- Subsidised public transportation ticket- Subsidised meal services- Childcare cost subsidyPlease note that Fairtrade International is strict on compliance with the required qualification criteria mentioned above, and only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
